devices.name: TURTLE BEACH VELOCITYONE FLIGHT THROTTLE QUADRANT

referenceNotes: In PC input mode the yoke and its attached quadrant enumerate as separate devices.
The left and right rudder triggers are two ends of the same signed axis.
In PC input mode select the QUAD instance even though it connects through the yoke.
Use the separate Windows PC USB connection to pair the rudder and two toe-brake axes.
Inputs are shown in PC mode. Learning is required for control names that depend on the active orientation or trim setting.
The touchpad is a mouse controller on Windows. FMD hardware menu navigation stays on the device.
The Flightstick II uses a separate USB connection in the PC HOTAS bundle.
Map shown in standard right-handed PC mode. The left-handed firmware setting swaps base numbering.
This is the independent Dual Throttle module used in the newer VelocityOne HOTAS bundle.
Default numbers follow the PC profile. The throttle grip lock and mechanical detent cartridge are hardware adjustments.
This is the separately enumerated stick of the VelocityOne Flightdeck.
The Windows touchpad movement is a mouse input. Physical press is included where the vendor maps it to a controller button.
